notes: Baseline. Deliberately empty: an empty settings_overlay plus an identity layer means the agent runs exactly as shipped, so v001 is a true no-op and every later version is a measurable delta from it. Drift in cfm_agent_v_5_0's own defaults is caught by RunRecord.package_fingerprint, which hashes MANIFEST.sha256, rather than by pinning values here. effective_from predates all available data on purpose: these are the constants v5.0 has always shipped with, so v001 was in force for any cutoff a replay might ask about. Dating it to the day the coach was written would instead assert that the agent had no calibration before then, which is false, and would make historical replay unresolvable.
